description: Guard (016 T014p, round-7 review F1, b04). A script start closes and reopens a script; CommonMark ends that block at the line, and a div block starts on the next line and runs to the blank line. The opener after the script's close has no closer before that blank line, and raw HTML passes through, so the browser's comment hides the marker after it. The digest on disk carries only the visible rule, so the check must say OK; harvesting the hidden marker would call this correct digest stale. c565240 kept the reopened script open past the line where CommonMark ends its block, missed the block starting inside it, and on the close returned to inline text, so the opener was disarmed and the marker harvested. Since 016 phase 2 (plan D8 and D11 as amended during phase 2) the marker passed over inside the comment is also reported by DIGEST-020, so the run fails naming its line; a mutation that harvests it drops that report and reads the digest stale.
